description: Envelope generator that makes one segment, a travel from one voltage to another over a set time, and grows more segments as F expanders are added to its right

params.text: Sets the voltage this segment arrives at, 0V to 10V
Bends this segment between its two voltages: a straight line in the middle, clockwise for a slow start and fast finish, anticlockwise for a fast start and slow finish
Sets how long this segment takes, 1ms to 10 seconds with a tenfold change every quarter turn; with SYNC on it reads as a fraction or multiple of a beat, from a sixteenth to sixteen
Takes this segment's length from the clock at the TRIGGER jack rather than from the DURATION knob's seconds
Sets the voltage the envelope sets off from each time it is started, 0V to 10V
When it is on, the chain sets off again from the START voltage the moment the last segment finishes, and keeps going until it is switched off
Starts the envelope from the START voltage

inputs.text: A rising edge through 1V starts the envelope from the START voltage, and is also the clock a synced segment measures its beat from

outputs.text: The envelope; between runs it holds the voltage the last segment finished on

notes: nothing comes out until a rising edge reaches TRIGGER or the MANUAL button is pressed. The output rests at 0V until the first run.
extra segments are F modules placed in an unbroken run to the right of this one, up to 64 of them; each adds one segment, in panel order left to right.
while any segment in the chain has SYNC on, an edge at TRIGGER arriving during a run is taken as a clock tick only and does not restart the envelope.
the clock is treated as gone if no edge arrives for four of its own periods, and synced segments fall back to the DURATION knob's seconds.
menu: Sync PPQN — how many pulses at the TRIGGER jack make one beat for a synced segment: 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 24 or 48

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
